{{Short description|German mathematician}}
[[Image:Müller detlef oberwolfach 2014.jpg|thumb|Müller at [[Oberwolfach]], 2014]]
'''Detlef Horst Müller''' (born 13 June 1954 in [[Dissen, Lower Saxony]])<ref>biographical and career information from Kürschner, Gelehrtenkalender 2009</ref> is a German mathematician, specializing in analysis.<ref>{{cite web|title=Prof. Dr. Detlef Müller|website=Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftliche Fakultät, Christian-Albrecths-Universität zu Kiel|url=http://www.math.uni-kiel.de/analysis/de/mueller/prof.-dr.-detlef-mueller}}</ref>

Müller received 1981 his doctorate from [[Bielefeld University]] with thesis ''Das Syntheseverhalten glatter Hyperflächen mit homogenen Krümmungsverhältnissen im <math>\mathbb R^n</math>'' (The synthesis behavior of smooth hypersurfaces with homogeneous curvature ratios in <math>\mathbb R^n</math>) under the supervision of Horst Leptin (1927–2017).<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|id=23599}}</ref> Müller [[Habilitation|habilitated]] in 1984 in Kiel. He spent the academic year 1990–1991 at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]]. He was from 1992 to 1994 a professor at the [[Université Louis Pasteur]] in [[Strasbourg]] and is since 1994 a professor at the [[University of Kiel]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Detlef Horst Müller|website=IAS|date=9 December 2019 |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/detlef-horst-müller}}</ref>

His research deals with [[harmonic analysis]] (especially related to [[Lie group]]s) with applications to [[partial differential equation]]s.

In 1998 Müller was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Müller, Detlef|chapter=Functional calculus on Lie groups and wave propagation|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. II|year=1998|pages=679–689|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011680000}}</ref> He became a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in the class of 2018. He is a member of the editorial boards of the ''Journal of Lie Theory'' and the ''[[Annali di Matematica Pura ed Applicata]]''.

*{{cite journal|doi=10.1090/S0002-9939-1994-1179590-7|title=A homogeneous, globally solvable differential operator on a nilpotent Lie group which has no tempered fundamental solution|journal=Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society|volume=121|pages=307–310|year=1994|last1=Müller|first1=Detlef|doi-access=free}}
*{{cite journal|last1=Muller|first1=Detlef|last2=Ricci|first2=Fulvio|title=Solvability for a Class of Doubly Characteristic Differential Operators on 2-Step Nilpotent Groups|journal=The Annals of Mathematics|volume=143|issue=1|year=1996|pages=1|issn=0003-486X|doi=10.2307/2118651|jstor=2118651}}
*{{cite journal|doi=10.1090/S0002-9939-01-05930-5|year=2001|last1=Müller|first1=Detlef|title=Local solvability for positive combinations of generalized sub-Laplacians on the Heisenberg group|journal=Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society|volume=129|issue=10|pages=3101–3108|last2=Zhang|first2=Zhenqiu|doi-access=free}}
*{{cite journal|doi=10.1090/S0002-9947-02-03232-4|year=2003|last1=Müller|first1=Detlef|title=Non-solvability for a class of left-invariant second-order differential operators on the Heisenberg group|journal=Transactions of the American Mathematical Society|volume=355|issue=5|pages=2047–2065|last2=Peloso|first2=Marco M.|doi-access=free}}
*{{cite journal|author=Müller, D.|title=Local solvability of linear differential operators with double characteristics. I. Necessary conditions|journal=Math. Ann.|volume=340|issue=1|year=2008|pages=23–75|doi=10.1007/s00208-007-0138-7|s2cid=14294846}}
*{{cite journal|doi=10.1090/S0002-9939-2014-12453-1|title=Uniqueness of solutions to Schrödinger equations on 2-step nilpotent Lie groups|journal=Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society|volume=142|issue=6|pages=2101–2118|year=2014|last1=Ludwig|first1=Jean|last2=Müller|first2=Detlef|arxiv=1207.4652}}
*with Marco Peloso, Fulvio Ricci: [https://books.google.com/books?id=cGcoBgAAQBAJ Analysis of the Hodge Laplacian on the Heisenberg group], Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society 2016
